description:
Full Suspension MTB with Castellano Flexstay.
First designed a quarter century ago, the original Ti Cycles KGP was a short travel cross country rig with a flex-stay design that leveraged the inherent compliance of tubular titanium chainstays to provide for suspended rear wheel travel without the need for lower pivot bearings, reducing weight while increasing lateral stability and durability.
For a reboot of the KGP platform to make noise in today’s mountain bike market we knew that it needed to be bigger and better, so we teamed up with legendary bike designer John Castellano to redesign his fantastic water-jet cut flex-plate stays around 27.5+ wheels for a NAHBS 2019 re-launch. Video Interview with John and Dave.
The end result is nothing short of an absolute winner that offers more of everything -- more travel, more tire, more rear end stability -- while maintaining the classic look and feel of the original rocker link suspension design.
